column1: # The cases rb test does not grade on the c-only image, because the c-only row does not install the program that they need. MKCXX=no turns off MKGCCCMDS and MKGDB (share/mk/bsd.own.mk), so the image has no cc, c++, cpp or gdb (plan 10.5). netbsd-r.yml gives this file to rb test as --ungraded when it grades the c-only image.

# A line is the suite, the case and the reason, separated by tabs. The list is the cases that the graded RR image passed and the c-only image did not, in run 43490485642, with the reason that atf-run gave.
